retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait of a man in western attire leaning against a wooden bar, featuring high-contrast serif typography overlaid across the chest and bottom edge.
triggerTerms: cowboy portrait in a rustic bar
western album cover with serif text
man in black cowboy hat and plaid shirt
excludeWhen: urban or futuristic themes are needed
sans-serif modernism is the primary goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man wearing a black cowboy hat and a dark plaid button-down shirt, seated at a polished wooden bar. The lighting is warm and directional, creating a soft glow on the face while the background remains in a shallow, out-of-focus blur of a rustic interior. Large white serif text is positioned horizontally across the center-left, with smaller, widely spaced serif text at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with a slight lean toward the right
High-contrast white text against the dark patterns of the plaid shirt
Warm interior tones contrasting with the cool blues of the denim and shirt
Linear perspective of the bar leading the eye toward the subject's hand
coreInvariants: Black felt cowboy hat with a traditional crease
Dark-toned plaid shirt with fine white grid lines
Shallow depth of field blurring the background shelving and bottles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-full shot, centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the black cowboy hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the large central text, follow the arm to the bar, and settle on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, out-of-focus areas in the upper corners and lower left provide breathing room for the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and blacks from the clothing and hat.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and ambers from the wooden bar and background lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the primary and secondary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and dark clothing; moderate saturation in the skin tones and wood.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Traditional transitional serif with high stroke contrast.
letterConstructionRules: Large display text uses tight tracking
Secondary text uses extreme letter spacing (tracking)

treatment.shadow: Subtle soft drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and tracking contrast; large bold title case paired with small spaced-out all-caps.
graphicDevices: Thin black border framing the entire image

preserve: Extreme tracking on the bottom line
avoid: Centered alignment for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, authoritative serif look of the main title.
Provides the elegant high-contrast strokes seen in the typography.
Offers similar legibility and weight for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a black cowboy hat and a dark blue/black plaid shirt sitting at a rustic wooden bar. Use warm, cinematic lighting with a shallow depth of field so the background bottles and shelves are blurred.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, bold white serif font across the center-left. Add a secondary subtitle in small, all-caps white serif font with wide letter spacing in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main text bold and white?
Is the bottom text all-caps with wide spacing?
Is the subject wearing a black cowboy hat and plaid shirt?
Is the background a blurred rustic interior?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'George Strait'
Do not use the specific album title 'Always Never The Same'
Do not replicate the specific belt buckle design

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's face
Clean, legible typography despite the busy shirt pattern

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the white text is readable against the plaid shirt.
Verify the black border is present around the image.
Confirm the bottom text is properly spaced and aligned to the right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Attire] + [Setting] + [Lighting Style] + [Primary Serif Typography Position] + [Secondary Spaced Typography Position]
